name: California

benefitCategories.medical: All reasonable treatment per Medical Treatment Utilization Schedule (MTUS)
benefitCategories.temporaryDisability: 2/3 of wages, max $1,619.15/week (2024); up to 104 weeks
benefitCategories.permanentDisability: Based on AMA Guides 5th Ed with CA modifiers; schedule by impairment %
benefitCategories.supplementalJobDisplacement: $6,000 voucher if employer doesn't offer modified work
benefitCategories.deathBenefits: $250,000-$320,000 depending on dependents; burial up to $10,000

appealLevels.name: WCAB Trial Level
appealLevels.deadline: 1 year from injury or 5 years for some benefits

workersCompensation.enforcementPowers: DWC audits; penalties for late/denied benefits; fraud investigation unit
workersCompensation.penalties: 10% penalty for late TD payments; up to $10,000 for bad faith denial; criminal fraud prosecution

programs.name: State Disability Insurance
programs.eligibility: Non-work-related illness/injury; earned $300+ in base period; under physician care
programs.wcInteraction: Cannot receive SDI and workers' comp TD simultaneously for same condition

programs.name: Paid Family Leave
programs.eligibility: Care for seriously ill family member or bond with new child

programs.name: State Supplementary Payment
programs.wcInteraction: WC income reduces SSI/SSP dollar-for-dollar after exclusions

programs.name: In-Home Supportive Services
programs.eligibility: Medi-Cal eligible; need assistance with daily living
programs.wcInteraction: WC medical does not affect IHSS eligibility

statutes.name: Fair Employment and Housing Act (FEHA)
statutes.protections: Broader disability definition than ADA; includes perceived disability, medical condition, genetic information

statutes.name: California Family Rights Act (CFRA)
statutes.protections: 12 weeks job-protected leave; broader than FMLA

civilRightsFramework.retaliationProhibitions: FEHA prohibits retaliation for filing complaints, participating in investigations, or requesting accommodations

accommodationObligations.standard: Reasonable accommodation; broader interactive process than ADA
accommodationObligations.process: Good faith interactive process mandatory; employer must initiate

enablingStatutes.disability: Unemployment Insurance Code; Welfare & Institutions Code

occupationalSafety.coverage: State plan state; covers public and private sector

filingDeadlines.wcClaim: 1 year from injury; 5 years for death benefits
filingDeadlines.fehaCrd: 3 years from discriminatory act to file with CRD
filingDeadlines.fehaLawsuit: 1 year from CRD right-to-sue (or file directly in court)
filingDeadlines.calOshaComplaint: No strict deadline but prompt filing recommended

evidentiaryStandards.wc: Preponderance of evidence; medical evidence must be substantial
evidentiaryStandards.feha: Prima facie case shifting burden to employer

judicialReview.wc: WCAB reconsideration → Court of Appeal writ (45 days) → Supreme Court
judicialReview.feha: Superior Court trial de novo after CRD; direct filing option
